about: What other code and users rely on, a line each, and the test that keeps it. `node tests/map.js --contracts` checks every cited test still exists and each listed module's surface (exports, its classes' methods, the design-redux events it sends or hears) is as recorded in tests/snapshots/contracts.json; after a deliberate change, --contracts --update.

invariants.rule: What's picked stays apart from what's open; pinned, the inspector follows neither; a deleted target is let go
invariants.test: mobile: docked in the sidebar, the panel stays open and follows the note and what the library picks

invariants.rule: While the inspector shows, a click in the library picks and a double click or Enter opens
invariants.test: album: the inspector: while it shows, a click in the library picks

invariants.rule: Note, album and card are drawn through one inspectable each; the panel only holds them
invariants.test: bulk: the inspector’s targets: a text card’s properties changed and taken away at its top

invariants.rule: Writes go through plugin.notes.write; Undo puts back only what's still as the change left it
invariants.test: bulk: undo puts back what’s still as the change left it, keeps what was edited since

invariants.rule: Each write's changes are kept, a value put back alone
invariants.test: bulk: property history: each write’s changes kept

invariants.rule: Pins keep your order and follow a rename, forget a deletion
invariants.test: qol: arranged pins follow a rename and forget a deletion

invariants.rule: Album orders follow a note renamed, moved, deleted, and a folder renamed
invariants.test: album: arrangements follow a note renamed in place, moved away, deleted, and a folder renamed

invariants.rule: A move is one step of Undo that puts it back, order and all
invariants.test: album: a move says so with an Undo, which puts it back, album order and all

invariants.rule: Ticked with Shift for a run; moved together, one Undo for all
invariants.test: album: editing an album, notes ticked — Shift for a run — are moved together, one Undo putting them all back

invariants.rule: A file that can't be read is never written
invariants.test: mindmap: a file that can’t be read is shown as it is, with what went wrong, and never written

invariants.rule: A change made outside while typing loses nothing on either side
invariants.test: mindmap: the note changed outside while typing

invariants.rule: History is kept before a save and put back as one step of Undo
invariants.test: mindmap: map history: a state kept before a save after a pause

invariants.rule: Command ids, setting keys and view types are kept, or moved by a tested migration
invariants.test: lifecycle: command ids, setting keys and view types are kept

invariants.rule: Settings from an older version open with nothing lost, a backup first
invariants.test: album: 1.x settings open on 2.0 with nothing lost
